title: Crate
prompt: Create a placed crate furniture (with model models/crate.json) and a crate key item; right-clicking the crate with a key consumes it, gives one of five weighted rewards, and announces rare drops.

replay.note: The dry run reports MTR-0009 for texture 'block/crate', a default the furniture scaffold writes beside a model that resolves to nothing in the pack (benchmark S18). The list is otherwise accepted: the model resolves (the core writes the uploaded asset by the server's path convention since #355), and the rule on furnitures/crate.yml, the key item and the choose all compile (the behavior stage ran).
